answer: Bond anchor: each agent locks saffron-equivalent stake in a vault to mint one identity. Attacker gains many accounts but forfeits one vault per sybil; honest agent pays once. Profit scales with identities, cost with locked capital, so the marginal sybil earns less than the bond risked. Equilibrium: sybils stop where expected gain equals forfeited vault. No attacker forges saffron without the anchor.
